Cover Letter

Dear Professor Welsch,

I came across AmplifAI and found myself reading the project overview twice — because it describes, almost precisely, the problem I have been independently working on from the other side of the world.

I am Go Kian Tik, an independent researcher based in Indonesia. Over the past several months I have developed the CHO Sovereign CF (Chief Humanity Officer – Sovereign Conceptual Framework) — an interdisciplinary corpus of 25+ peer-deposited works on Zenodo and SSRN, exploring why humans remain cognitively dissonant, overconfident, or "vacant" even when given powerful AI tools, and how to design for genuine human amplification rather than dependency.

"AmplifAI develops new ways to measure human–AI performance, enhance our self-awareness when working with AI, and design interfaces that truly amplify our minds."

— AmplifAI Project Overview, amplifyingthemind.com

This is precisely the territory my framework occupies. Here is where I believe our work intersects most directly:

On metrics for human–AI intelligence: My triadic framework Ruwet–OTW Genah–Genah DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19002243 introduces an operational diagnostic model for human cognitive readiness across seven layers of self-language — from verbal expression down to cellular communication. It could function as a pre/post AI-interaction state metric, directly addressing AmplifAI's goal to create benchmarks where none currently exist.

On overconfidence and over-reliance: My paper Titik Buta Berdaulat DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19265764 introduces the concept of Cognitive Vacancy — a structural self-knowledge gap that persists in high-achievers — and proposes: HE-AI = (Human Wisdom × AI Augmentation) ÷ Cognitive Vacancy as a working formula. This is a direct theoretical answer to AmplifAI's core concern about AI leaving people worse at thinking, not better.

On neuroscience and thinking with AI: Bahasa Diri: Dari Neurosains Hingga Keabadian DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19219823 maps self-language from verbal to cellular/epigenetic layers — offering a framework for understanding what is happening inside the human during AI interaction, relevant to AmplifAI's neuroscience methods.

Beyond the conceptual contributions, I bring a practical digital ecosystem — GitHub Pages prototypes, interactive frameworks co-developed with AI, and a growing practitioner community (Zì Zhǔ Zhě / Superhero Café Inside) — that could serve as a non-Western field site for AmplifAI's prototyping and evaluation work. This is a lens largely absent in current human-AI interaction research, which is heavily Nordic and Western.

I understand your team is preparing to advertise positions. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my existing corpus could complement AmplifAI's methodology — whether as a research affiliate, visiting collaborator, or formal team member.

With respect and genuine curiosity,

Go Kian Tik

Research Portfolio

Visual Framework Overview

Two visual anchors of the CHO Sovereign CF — each directly mapping to AmplifAI's stated research gaps.

Grand Formula · Civilizational Architecture

Grand Formula 1: A Civilizational Architecture for Cognitive Sovereignty

(Consciousness × Calculation)^Humanity < Transcendence

This formula proposes that Humanity must function as the exponent — not a variable to be optimized away. Where current AI benchmarks measure calculation speed and accuracy, Grand Formula 1 insists that consciousness and humanity-as-amplifier are the missing dimensions. This directly counters the AI overreliance problem AmplifAI identifies: when Humanity collapses to zero, even infinite Calculation produces nothing of transcendence.

Measure human–AI performance Expand human intelligence New benchmarks Global South lens
Pentadrant · Human Self-Coherence Framework

Pentadrant (E–S–B–I–G): Mapping Cognitive Failure Modes Across Human Roles

5 roles × specific cognitive traps × OTW Genah transition states

The Pentadrant extends Kiyosaki's four quadrants to five — adding Governmental (G) to account for Asia and Global South dynamics — and maps a distinct cognitive trap to each role. Critically for AmplifAI: each role's trap is a different form of human–AI misalignment. The Investor's trap ("Calculation without Consciousness") mirrors exactly the overreliance problem. The Business Owner's trap ("Humanity Gap") mirrors the loss of critical thinking. Each quadrant includes an OTW Genah state — the measurable transition toward coherence — offering a ready-made interface design target for adaptive AI tools.

Key Papers
I

Ruwet, OTW Genah, Genah: A Triadic Framework of Human Self-Coherence

Operational three-state framework for diagnosing cognitive readiness across seven self-language layers. Candidate metric for human baseline before/after AI interaction.

DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19002243
II

Titik Buta Berdaulat: LMC Mindset, Cognitive Vacancy, and the Paradox of Self-Knowledge

Introduces Cognitive Vacancy and Grand Formula 2: HE-AI = (Human Wisdom × AI Augmentation) ÷ Cognitive Vacancy. Direct theoretical response to AI overconfidence problem.

DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19265764
III

Bahasa Diri: Dari Neurosains Hingga Keabadian

Neurolinguistic framework mapping self-language from verbal to cellular/epigenetic layers — foundation for neuroscience-informed AI interaction design.

DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19219823
IV

The Sovereign One: The Human Prerequisite in the Era of AI-Accelerated Civilization

Defines the target human state for ability-centered AI design. The "Sovereign One" is the conceptual user-persona AmplifAI is designing toward — made explicit.

DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18935892
V

The 'Ribet' Breakthrough: How a Complex User Session Pushed Our LLM to New Frontiers

Empirical primary data from a real human–AI interaction session. A naturalistic observation of cognitive amplification in practice — rare non-lab evidence.

DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19182106
